sources.name: Acquire.com
sources.notes: Companies and modules for sale. Listings are visible only to signed-in buyers, so this needs stored credentials — which the system deliberately does not hold yet, and which is a decision to take on purpose rather than by default. Note the direction: an acquisition SPENDS money, so it is never added into a funding total.

sources.name: Abu Dhabi Investment Office — incentive programmes
sources.notes: Innovation and investment incentives for companies establishing in Abu Dhabi. Relevant through Oolala Next FZ-LLC — the entity route matters here more than the call itself. investabudhabi.ae does not resolve in DNS — the scout's first real attempt failed with ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, not with a refusal. Replaced with adio.ae and set back to unverified so the link checker has to confirm it.

sources.name: Aides-territoires
sources.notes: Aggregates French aid for local authorities and associations, including REGIONAL schemes. The most direct answer to 'aid is under-represented'. Relevant above all to Les Vieilles Pierres and Maisons.co. Projets servis : Aides destinées aux collectivités et aux acteurs de territoire : patrimoine, tourisme local, fondations.

sources.name: BOAMP — Bulletin officiel des annonces de marchés publics
sources.notes: French public procurement INCLUDING below the European thresholds — the band where a studio this size actually wins. The highest-value source not yet connected. An open-data API is understood to exist; its shape has not been verified from this environment. Projets servis : Marchés publics français, y compris sous les seuils européens — le studio et l'advisory.

sources.name: Bpifrance
sources.notes:
Grants, repayable advances, guarantees and equity. Covers three of the kinds the taxonomy now distinguishes, which is why they were worth distinguishing.
BLOCKED as of the first real scout run: the URL answers an automated browser with CloudFront "403 ERROR — Request blocked". Same reasoning as Région Bretagne — the refusal is deliberate and is respected rather than worked around. Use the console's paste-a-link intake.

sources.name: Research and innovation tax credits (CIR, CII, JEI)
sources.notes: Not a call site and never will be: a fiscal status claimed on a filing. It is listed because the taxonomy can now represent it — before TAX_INCENTIVE existed, a tax credit could not pass the gate at any evidence level. The entreprises.gouv.fr URL first published here returned HTTP 404 on the first real link check — a dead link in the exact place this product exists to prevent. Replaced with the service-public.fr reference page, and set back to unverified so the checker has to confirm the new one rather than inheriting the old one's word. Projets servis : Dispositifs fiscaux R&D : tout projet produit porté par une entité française.

sources.name: EU Funding & Tenders portal (SEDIA)
sources.notes: Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, Creative Europe, EIC. The connector exists and is exercised against a recorded response only — it has never completed a live run. Status stays FIXTURE_ONLY until one does. Projets servis : Horizon, Digital Europe, Creative Europe : produits logiciels et culturels.

sources.name: Flippa
sources.notes: Digital assets and small software businesses. Public listings; no connector. Projets servis : Acquisitions éventuelles — le studio seul décide d'acheter.

sources.name: France 2030 / ADEME calls
sources.notes: National programme calls. Typically large consortia — relevant to BAWABA rather than to the smaller ventures. Projets servis : Innovation et transition : produits logiciels et le studio comme opérateur.

sources.name: Hub71
sources.notes: Abu Dhabi tech ecosystem: incentive packages and cohorts. One Hub71 record already sits in the dataset from the Milestone-0 seed, entered by hand — this entry makes that source explicit rather than incidental.

sources.name: Malt, Comet and French consulting marketplaces
sources.notes: Visible only to signed-in members, which makes scraping both a terms question and a credentials question. Manual intake until there is a reason to resolve both.

sources.name: Région Bretagne — aides et appels à projets
sources.notes:
Regional aid for Brittany: heritage, culture, tourism, digital, business development. Explicitly requested. No machine access identified — watched by hand, and anything found goes through the manual intake so it lands in the same ledger with the same verification.
BLOCKED as of the first real scout run: the site answers an automated browser with a Cloudflare security challenge ("Vérification de sécurité en cours… protège contre les bots malveillants"). That is an access control the operator put up deliberately, so OIA does not try to defeat it — defeating it is not a technical problem to solve, it is a decision the site owner already made. The supported path is the console's paste-a-link intake: open the page yourself, paste the URL of a scheme worth having, and it enters the pipeline with the same checks as everything else.

sources.name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
sources.notes: Above-EU-threshold public procurement. A real run retrieved from it and the response is the repository's test fixture. Covers only contracts ABOVE the European thresholds — the ones a studio of this size wins are usually below, which is why BOAMP matters more.

sources.name: UAE federal and emirate procurement portals
sources.notes: Each emirate and several federal entities run their own portal, most requiring supplier registration. No single machine-readable index is known to exist. Treated as manual watch rather than pretending a connector is coming. Projets servis : Marchés publics fédéraux émiriens : les projets portés par l'entité AE.

sources.name: Find a Tender (UK)
sources.notes: The UK's post-Brexit equivalent of TED. Publishes an OCDS feed, which would make it the second-easiest connector after TED. Projets servis : Marchés publics britanniques : le studio, l'advisory sport, la plateforme souveraine.

sources.name: UN Global Marketplace
sources.notes: UN agency procurement. One UNESCO record in the dataset came from here, entered by hand. Registration required to bid; the notices themselves are public. Projets servis : Appels des organisations internationales : le studio et les fondations.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.notes: Clients posting paid software work. An API exists behind OAuth, and the terms of service govern what may be automated — so this is BLOCKED rather than DECLARED until that is read properly. Postings found by hand go through the manual intake today.

sources.name: Development bank procurement (World Bank, AfDB, EBRD)
sources.notes: Sport, leisure and social infrastructure in emerging markets — the realistic route for padel.design and District 267, neither of which any European source covers.
